problem.statement: GDN Chunk Forward Pitfalls (CuTeDSL, SM120) -- 10. D-1 "all-warps-produce-and-consume" is broken with PipelineTmaAsync

payload.attempted: You design a TMA kernel where all warps both produce and consume (the D-1 pattern from ``). Every warp calls `producer_acquire` → `cute.copy` → `producer_commit`, then all warps call `consumer_wait`. Seems elegant — no warp specialization needed, all warps stay busy.
payload.lesson: PipelineTmaAsync requires **warp specialization** — only the designated producer warp(s) call `producer_acquire` / `cute.copy` / `producer_commit`. The D-1 pattern (all-warps-produce-and-consume) does NOT work. Use:
